text:
Arshdeep Bains is a hometown story: born in Surrey, never drafted, and a 112-point WHL season at Red Deer before he earned a contract with his local team. Now 25, he is trying to hold an NHL job on a Canucks team that has struggled badly, and it has been an in-and-out fall. The Hockey News reported him slotting back into the lineup against Edmonton on Nov. 8.

The production is modest: one goal and three points in 15 games at about 10.8 minutes a night, with seven shots. Our numbers say he isn't far off his chances, since his goals match his expected goals almost exactly. The on-ice picture is weaker. Vancouver has controlled 42.9% of expected goals with him at five on five, though that is a bit better than the team without him.

He is also under the microscope defensively. After the Oilers game, Daniel Wagner of Pass it to Bulis wrote that it was "some rough defending by Bains on that Ekholm goal." Watch whether he keeps his spot as the lineup changes.
headline: Bains is fighting for a fourth-line spot
